hero.eyebrow: Emerging leaders · Built for the moments that matter
hero.headline: Leadership is built in moments.
hero.subheadline: Leadra is a behavioural development app for emerging leaders. It helps you recognise the pressure spikes, difficult conversations, and unexpected changes — and build the capabilities to navigate them with confidence.

capabilities.heading: Five capabilities. One leadership identity.
capabilities.subtext: Each capability is taught through micro-moments, short practice tasks, and immediate reflection loops — ensuring learning is contextual, frequent, and measurable.

how_it_works.heading: Grounded in behavioural science.
how_it_works.subtext: Leadra translates evidence-based principles from leadership development, organisational behaviour, and coaching into a practical, in-the-moment learning system.

pillars.heading: Deliberate practice
pillars.body: Learning applied to real workplace tasks, with repeated and spaced practice, produces higher impact and better retention.

pillars.heading: Behavioural principles
pillars.body: Small, observable behaviours shaped by clear prompts and timely feedback produce measurable changes in how you lead.

pillars.heading: Personalised feedback
pillars.body: Combining micro-coaching with automated nudges increases self-efficacy and translates insight into real-world action.

playbook.headline: Start with the Emerging Leaders Playbook.
playbook.body: A self-directed workbook covering five core leadership capabilities — with 7-day practice plans, reflection exercises, and in-the-moment scripts. Use it alongside the Leadra app or as a standalone resource.
modules: Module 2: Critical Thinking — decision filters and probes
Module 3: Situational Judgement — reading the moment
Module 4: Change Agility — staying steady through uncertainty

pricing.heading: Choose how you grow.
pricing.subtext: Start free. Move to a plan when you're ready. No lock-in.

tiers.name: Professional
tiers.tagline: For emerging leaders building real habits

pricing.footnote_trial: All plans include a 14-day free trial. Cancel any time.
pricing.footnote_testing: Essentials and Professional are free while we're in testing — pricing will be introduced before general launch.

community.heading: A community of leaders who reflect, not just react.
community.body: The Leadra community is being built. A space for emerging leaders to share moments, compare patterns, and support each other's growth. Get early access when we launch.

get_access.heading: Ready to build your leadership identity?
get_access.subtext: Leadra is available now as a web app. A Telegram mini app is coming soon. Start with the free playbook, or jump straight into the app.
